implementation.targetScope: Eleven components: button controls, Typography, Link, SvgIcon and Box; createSvgIcon; scoped ThemeProvider, useTheme, styled, GlobalStyles, useThemeProps, useMediaQuery and useColorScheme over VPM System. Accepts existing resolved plain/CSS-variable Material themes and nested callbacks. Full Material theme creation and remaining component families are not implemented.
implementation.remainingWork: Forms and validation controls; remaining surfaces and data display; navigation, menus, tabs and overlays; full Material theme creation and remaining app-used exports; whole-app integration and consumer release.

changes: Written independently over VPM System and its styling closure; no upstream Material runtime, Babel or prop-types ships.
Native button semantics and direct React rendering; no imperative HTML insertion.
Owned refs and ripple timers are released on unmount; theme changes retain control DOM.
Independent Typography, Link and SvgIcon plus createSvgIcon; no Material runtime dependency. Actual current/app Material icon modules render unchanged above the VPM factory.
Retains Material 7 paragraph, direct system props and CSS/palette-path colors needed by existing callers alongside the current typography contract. Physical text alignment is preserved in RTL.

Explicit root accessibility attributes override nested SVG attributes; titleAccess promotes a decorative SVG child to a named image unless the root explicitly hides it. Prototype-named variants and sizes do not read inherited object properties.

Custom component roots receive native button type/disabled semantics by default, matching Material 9; nativeButton:false explicitly selects ARIA semantics. Browser acceptance covers the application combination of IconButton, motion.button, inherited variants, theme rerenders and ref cleanup.

Independent Material Box and scoped theme bridge, including $$material isolation, nested callback providers and CSS-variable themes. Retains direct System props used by app 7.2.0, which current Material 9 removed. Fuse-style SVG sprite roots are browser checked.

caller.scope: Navigation actions, contest forms, family area/reminder toggles, palette selector and navbar Fab. Building this subset does not switch VentiMath dependencies. Navigation search and link roots, theme typography and icon sizing, and @mui/icons-material consumers in MustangMath, I2MC and IMO. FuseSvgIcon instead uses styled Box, SVG sprite references and an Icon fallback. Material icons and FuseSvgIcon are distinct callers. Shared external-link actions combine IconButton with motion.button and inherited variants.
